sources.claim: CISA and partners report that Black Basta affiliates have used QakBot during initial access.
MITRE ATT&CK describes QakBot as a malware family that evolved into a delivery agent for ransomware operations.

curator_note: Modeled from the ransomware-campaign perspective: Black Basta affiliates used QakBot during initial access. This is not code lineage or operator continuity.
confidence_reason: The CISA advisory provides the direct Black Basta/QakBot campaign claim; MITRE supports QakBot's broader ransomware-delivery role.
